claims.text: BLIND SPOT (scope claim): a clean checkCIF result (no A/B alerts) establishes only that the CIF is internally consistent under the check.def suite. It does NOT establish that the structure is chemically correct, that the claimed chemistry is the chemistry in the crystal, or that the dataset is genuine — IUCr states in every report that the absence of alerts does not guarantee there are no aspects needing attention, and internally consistent fabricated datasets are known to pass.
